Before you go

Your pre-trip checklist

A little preparation makes room for better conversations. Your ticks and event choices are kept in this page's URL fragment, not sent to a server. Bookmark the updated URL to keep them; sharing it also shares those choices.

Your conference, in Whova

Use the organizer's invitation to find PPCC 2026. The conference app is your first stop for current rooms, updates, and attendee connections.

  1. 01 / Sign in

    Use your registration email

    Install Whova from the organizer's invitation and sign in with the email used for your conference registration. If PPCC does not appear, ask the organizer for access.

  2. 02 / Make a plan

    Build your agenda and a backup

    Find your sessions, add them to My Agenda, and check each day's times and rooms. Review organizer announcements before heading to your next stop.

  3. 03 / Connect

    Meet people and keep learning

    Explore Attendees and Community for peer conversations and meetups. Look for shared session materials and evaluations where provided; do not assume a recording is available.

Whova attendee guideGo to your checklist

Use only the current invitation or access code supplied by the organizer. This guide does not publish an unconfirmed code or a guessed event-portal link.

Optional / separately booked

Make room for a workshop

Pre-conference workshops run October 25-26; post-conference workshops run October 30. They are not included in the main conference pass and must be booked separately.

Check your chosen workshop's prerequisites and exact hours. For hands-on sessions, bring a fully charged laptop and power cord.

On the ground

Get oriented before you arrive

The MGM Grand is a large venue. Use the official property map for orientation and the conference app for current session rooms.

Venue maps you can explore

Select a thumbnail to open a larger view. Pinch or scroll to zoom, drag to move, or use the buttons and keyboard.

Source: resort map image in your PPCC26 KBYG deck. The two detail views are crops of that same image, not separate conference floor plans. Its annotations and businesses may be outdated; use the current official property PDF, on-site signs, and conference app for final wayfinding. Floor-by-floor conference maps are not included.

The official map

MGM Grand property map

Open the venue PDF for detailed wayfinding and zoom controls. A resort map is not a substitute for the current conference floor plan.

Open property map (PDF)

Know your next room

These are the rooms currently listed for your featured sessions. Confirm the floor and route in Whova or with on-site staff before walking.

For registration, badge pickup, and the Expo, follow the organizer's current app and signage. No unverified floor assignments or pickup hours are assumed here.

Open the organizer's published schedule (PDF)

A simpler keynote morning

  1. Collect your badge first

    Confirm pickup location and opening hours in your registration email. Where offered, collect it the day before the main conference.

  2. Check the room before leaving

    Use the current agenda and on-site signage. Leave walking time between the conference center and other resort spaces.

  3. Arrive with a buffer

    The published opening keynote is Tuesday, October 27, 8:30-10:00 AM. Recheck the schedule and entry requirements before setting out.

  4. Have your next stop ready

    Choose a session and a backup. Schedule breaks and a meeting window instead of filling every minute.

Your destination

MGM Grand
3799 S. Las Vegas Blvd.
Las Vegas, NV 89109

Fly into Harry Reid International Airport (LAS). Check your hotel's transportation guidance and allow for traffic.

Hotel and resort information

Pack for long days

Comfortable shoes, a light layer, a phone charger, and space in your schedule. Confirm dietary or accessibility needs directly with the organizer.

All guide times are Pacific (Las Vegas). Confirm final room assignments in the conference app.
